## What to expect

Bogotá introduces you to colonial La Candelaria, the Gold Museum, works by Fernando Botero and the central Bolívar Square. The program also includes a coffee tasting, where a local specialist explains balance, aroma, acidity and different brewing methods.

The route then heads into the Cundiboyacense highlands. You will see the Salt Cathedral of Zipaquirá, the basilica in Chiquinquirá, Ráquira and Villa de Leyva with its colonial architecture. The following day continues at Pozos Azules and the Paleontological Research Centre.

In the Coffee Region, you will first visit Filandia, with its colonial streets and Quindío viewpoint, followed by the Cocora Valley, cloud forest, wax palms and Salento. A separate day is devoted to a coffee farm in Santa Rosa de Cabal, where you can see the entire coffee processing cycle.

After Pereira, you fly to the Caribbean coast. In Santa Marta, the program includes a city tour and a full day in Tayrona National Park, following the route to Cabo San Juan. The journey then continues in Cartagena: sunset on the bay, a city tour of the historic center and a fishing and local cuisine experience in a nearby village.
